info.title: ProjectOps API
info.description: Autonomous multi-agent project execution and risk management system. Deterministic scheduling, immutable versioned plans, and append-only audits.

schema.title: Response List Projects Api V1 Projects Get

post.description: Add a team member to a project.

get.description: List members assigned to a project.

schema.title: Response List Project Members Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Members Get

post.description: Submit a new immutable plan snapshot (Rule 5: version increment, no overwrite).

get.description: Fetch the currently active plan snapshot.
List all immutable version numbers available for a project.
Retrieve an immutable historical plan snapshot by its version number.
Run deterministic CPM schedule on active or versioned plan.

parameters.name: version

schema.description: Specific plan version; defaults to active
schema.title: Version

parameters.description: Specific plan version; defaults to active

post.description:
Run what-if scenario simulation without saving to database.

Core Principle 3: Replans are simulated by the deterministic scheduler.
Append a task progress event to the audit trail (Rule 5: append-only).

get.description: Retrieve chronological progress history for a project or specific task.

schema.title: Response List Progress History Api V1 Projects  Project Id  History Progress Get

post.description: Record a replan or governance decision (Rule 4: Replanning requires approval).

get.description: Retrieve all governance and replan decisions for a project.

schema.title: Response List Decisions Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Decisions Get

post.description: Record a detected risk anomaly in the immutable risk register.

get.description: Retrieve all risk anomaly events recorded for a project.

schema.title: Response List Risks Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Risks Get
